description: What is on the ground at a point, in one call: the admin units, ward and pincode; land cover, elevation and slope, population density and block land use; climate zones; the river basin, nearest river, water body, dam and wetland, and flood history; hazards (seismic zone, landslides, cyclone tracks, coastal regulation zone); forests and protected areas with the nearest one; the nearest highway, railway and metro station, airport and bus stop; the nearest hospital (three sources) and school, and places within 1 km; the nearest power line, power plant and water-supply facility; distance to India's outline. Returns a one-line `summary` and `sections`, each with its credit, licence, scale, vintage and status; for the air above the point, `air` points to the mugilu MCP's conditions_at. Example: 'what is around this plot in Kolkata?' -> lat: 22.57, lng: 88.36.

open_only.description: true leaves out the non-commercial layers (for commercial use); default false

name: surface_at
